name: Arctic Assault
blurb: Active:  Sejuani  dashes to the target location, dealing magic damage and briefly  knocking up enemies she passes through. She will stop upon hitting an enemy  champion.

effects.description: Active: Bristle dashes to the target location until he collides with an enemy champion, dealing magic damage to enemies he passes through and knocking them up for 0.5 seconds.
Arctic Assault can be cast during her other abilities without cancelling them and vice versa.

notes:
Arctic Assault has no minimum dash range.
Champions will be slightly  knocked back, while minions and monsters will instead be slightly  pulled for a fixed distance. Neither can displace through terrain.
Casting  Flash during Arctic Assault will end the dash and affect enemies at the new location.
If the dash collides with an enemy champion, Sejuani will be ordered to basic attack them.
